result.summary: Require descriptor flags to be validated even when a wallet database is missing a FLAGS record, rejecting SQLite wallets without flags as legacy wallets with a graceful error instead of an assertion failure. Additionally, update the `bitcoin-wallet` tool during wallet creation to avoid loading the empty database prior to writing flags and version metadata.
result.problem: A SQLite wallet file missing a FLAGS record is treated as having no flags set, causing the loader to interpret it as a legacy wallet. This triggers an assertion failure either in `SetupLegacyDataSPKM` (if legacy records are present) or in `LoadActiveScriptPubKeyMan` (if absent), aborting the node on `loadwallet` or during startup if the wallet is set to autoload.
evidence: Regtest reproduction provided by author in description: on master, deleting the FLAGS record causes node aborts at `wallet.cpp:3577` or `wallet.cpp:3404`; with this PR, it returns error -4 and the node remains running.
Functional test `wallet_descriptor.py` added showing graceful -4 RPC error ('Wallet is a legacy wallet.') instead of crashing.
result.changed_since_previous: No functional or commit changes; the previous description was generated without a diff patch.
result.card: Reject SQLite wallets missing a FLAGS record with a graceful error instead of crashing the node. Missing FLAGS records previously caused the wallet loader to fall back to legacy handling and trigger unhandled assertions in SetupLegacyDataSPKM or LoadActiveScriptPubKeyMan, crashing the node on loadwallet or startup. The PR also adjusts bitcoin-wallet create so it no longer loads an empty database during creation.

risk.why: A mistake could reject valid wallet files or misconfigure newly initialized wallets created via the bitcoin-wallet tool.
